boundary: One operator runs every node and holds every actor key; separate keys are not independent administration.
Imports are facts only: no challenge code, no pull-request text, official_result false, no platform API.
A correction stops managed use of the first package; its Apache-2.0 bytes and the platform record are not revoked.
One Kyoei arm; the comparison with the reference and the other source mode is a separate step. product_result is null.
normalization: A published shared draft is stored as its own artifact; it travels inside the output it was published into, so package members list the output, not the working copy.
Kyoei releases name people only; the import is released with delegates allowed so the agents B and C delegate can be granted it, where the reference names the agents.
A dissent, a consent and an agent grant are signed by the issuing institution's node and deposited at A by its own actor, as leases are; the reference sends them node to node.
